headline: A 2014 law directs Congress to award a Congressional Gold Medal to Shimon Peres, the former Israeli president.
what_it_does: The law tells the Speaker of the House and the President pro tempore of the Senate to arrange a presentation of a Congressional Gold Medal honoring Shimon Peres. The medal is a symbolic honor given by Congress. The summary does not describe any money, rules, or services beyond arranging the presentation.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 9, 2014.
